# AI Engineering Labs

> Interactive lessons on how LLMs work and what they cost to serve, for software engineers. Plus small open-source tools.

## Pages

- [Home](index.md)
- [Lessons](lessons/index.md): course "LLM Foundations for engineers"
- [Tools](tools/index.md)
- [Write-ups](writeups/index.md)
- [About](about.md)

## Lessons

1. [Tokens, embeddings, attention](lessons/llm-foundations-1/index.md): 20 interactive steps
2. [The block, sampling, the KV cache](lessons/llm-foundations-2/index.md): 14 interactive steps
3. [Training and inference economics](lessons/llm-foundations-3/index.md): 14 interactive steps
4. [Give the model knowledge: RAG, vector search, evals](lessons/llm-foundations-4/index.md): 12 interactive steps
5. [Give the model hands: the agent loop and MCP](lessons/llm-foundations-5/index.md): 7 interactive steps
